subject: Television & Streaming
title: Fresh Prince to Black-ish: Evolving Representation
description: Learn Fresh Prince to Black-ish: Evolving Representation in one minute.

hook.text: In 1990, The Fresh Prince showed Will Smith navigating class differences.

buildup.text: Fresh Prince used comedy to explore culture clash. A kid from West Philadelphia moves to a wealthy Bel-Air family.

discovery.text: Black-ish went further, explicitly discussing racism, police brutality, and what it means to be Black in modern America.

twist.text: ABC shelved a 2018 Black-ish episode about kneeling during the anthem.

climax.text: The evolution from Fresh Prince to Black-ish shows TV gradually moving from diverse casting to centering diverse.

punchline.text: Representation went from being present to being heard.

quiz.question: How did Black-ish differ from earlier shows like The Fresh Prince?
options: It explicitly addressed racism and racial identity in contemporary America
